items.title: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds (chest) out for year, source says
items.text: Giants linebacker Tremaine Edmunds will miss the rest of the season with a torn chest muscle, a source told ESPN's Jordan Raanan. Edmunds leads the team with 50 tackles and wore the green dot to make the calls on defense.

items.title: Ravens' Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) unsure if he'll play
items.text: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson said he's dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unsure if he'll play this week against the Bengals, but is "heading in the right direction" after missing the past two games.

items.title: Browns RBs Quinshon Judkins, Dylan Sampson expected to play
items.text: The Browns' top two running backs, Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson, are expected to play against the Titans after being sidelined with injuries.

items.title: Bears TE Cole Kmet out for season after knee injury vs. Patriots
items.text: Bears tight end Cole Kmet will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after he suffered a serious right knee injury during Chicago's 30-24 win over New England.

items.title: Falcons' viral stripes will appear down center of helmets
items.text: A vertical stripe pattern that the Falcons used in a social media post will appear down the middle of the team's throwback helmets. The stripes drew significant online backlash as some saw similarity to Nazi Germany imagery.

items.title: Cam Skattebo set to return to Giants RB mix after being 'taught a lesson'
items.text: After zero carries in Week 6, Cam Skattebo says he took a step back to evaluate and correct, and Giants' coach says he should return to the running back mix vs. the Texans.

items.title: Rams WR Puka Nacua misses practice, questionable vs. Raiders with calf injury
items.text: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua (calf) will not practice Friday and is questionable to play Sunday against the Raiders, coach Sean McVay said.
